question.prompt:
At the \(2013\) Winnebago County Fair a vendor is offering a “fair special” on sandals. If you buy one pair of sandals at the regular price of \(\$50,\) you get a second pair at a \(40 \%\) discount, and a third pair at half the regular price.

Javier took advantage of the “fair special” to buy three pairs of sandals. What percentage of the \(\$150\) regular price did he save?

solutions.explanation:
A \(40\%\) discount means paying \(60\%\) of the regular price. Thus the second pair costs \(50\cdot0.60=30\) dollars, and the third pair costs \(50\div2=25\) dollars.

Javier pays \(50+30+25=105\) dollars, saving \(150-105=45\) dollars. To find the percentage saved, compare this savings with the regular total:
\[
\frac{45}{150}=0.30=30\%.
\]
He saved \(30\%\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Find the prices and total savings
